cohort: 7551 nulliparous women with singleton deliveries, ≥37 weeks gestation, Bishop Score ≤6, induced with dinoprostone, misoprostol or transcervical single balloon catheter
finding: Balloon catheter is the most effective induction method with respect to time-to-delivery in nulliparous women at term compared with prostaglandin methods.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in mode of delivery between the three induction methods studied (balloon catheter, misoprostol, dinoprostone).
